margin_mm.description: Omitted/null defaults to 10 mm; numeric zero is a valid zero margin.

overlap_mm.description: Tiled overlap 0–20 mm; omitted/null defaults to 5 mm when tile is true. Nonzero overlap requires tile.

scale.description: Omitted/null fits a single page; explicit zero refuses. Tiling requires an explicit scale. Actual fit/page-count is checked during rendering.

tile.description: Tile at explicit scale, up to 16 pages in row-major order. False retains single-page fit/clip refusal.

preconditions: Object parameters; every field is optional. Page bounds and tiling/overlap relationships must hold; a complete circuit is not required
effects: Replace session PDF/PNG defaults, not a patch: omitted/null paper/orientation use letter/landscape, margin 10 mm, fit scale, grayscale/no measurement overlays and no tiling

snapshot.schematic_page exposes normalized settings. Defaults are not stored in circuit/recovery documents and do not dirty or alter graph, physics, history, selection or existing preview/export captures
An export's omitted/null page uses these defaults; a supplied page object replaces the defaults for that job. Validation here does not render or guarantee the chosen scale/layout will fit

errors.when: Malformed/unknown/duplicate fields, missing/null required fields, invalid path/kind/format/page parameters or incompatible options

x-page-relations: tile true requires explicit scale 0.1–4 points per schematic unit; no implicit shrinking
Each tile reserves an 18-point footer with page/grid/scale/overlap labels
Row-major complete viewBox coverage with overlap; at most 16 pages; oversized layouts fail before publication
PDF and print.submit include every page; multi-page PNG requires explicit zero-based page_index
Settings are session output choices; preserve graph, dirty state, simulation and history

dpi.description: PNG: omitted/null/zero means 150 dpi; otherwise 72–300. Nonzero refuses for other kinds.

page.description: Omitted/null uses snapshot.schematic_page; object is a complete per-job override with omitted fields reset to built-in defaults.

path.description: Required non-null nonblank literal local path, no NUL; relative resolves with filepath.Abs. ~ and environment variables are not expanded; other spaces remain literal. No parent creation or automatic extension. Must differ from the associated schematic, including filesystem aliases.

preview_id.description: Optional nonempty exact visible completed preview ID exports its original selected PNG bytes, even after editor edits or later preview close; no renderer/page/index/dpi override. Omitted/null/empty selects a new live capture.

preconditions: No active shared project operation and fewer than eight outstanding filesystem workers; canceling workers retain their slot
Valid destination and optional current document-generation guard; incomplete drawings may be exported without a successful solve
effects: Capture source at admission and perform encoding/destination checks/temp write/sync/publication outside the editor mutex; later graph, view, physics or recording choices cannot substitute their data
Preserve source file association/save point, current editor/selection/history/physics and kept membership; publish only job/artifact metadata. Runtime jobs are not saved

Exact associated path refuses at admission; parent-directory aliases and same-file identities refuse in worker preparation and are checked again before publication. Explicit overwrite never authorizes replacing the associated schematic

Existing regular destinations require overwrite=true. Recheck captured destination identity/content before rename; new targets publish exclusively. Reject final links/special files and oversized output; clean temp files before terminal completion

Source replacement/Close before publication supersedes work. Publishing is noncancelable and can finish after replacement, with original provenance and false associated_with_current_document; it cannot associate an export as the new project file
last_export and retained project work expose captured generation/run/electrical or record identity, byte count and SHA-256. Association describes completion time, not later editor/disk equality

Admission consumes the actor/retry key even after later file failure; use a new key for corrected intent. Identical immediate-start retries return original admission; waiting retries return the original terminal outcome without another write
Filesystem checks/rename are not compare-and-swap against arbitrary outside writers; blocked OS calls may outlast cooperative deadlines. Directory sync is best effort, not power-loss qualification

Scope kind captures fresh selected live rows/window/units even while recorded view is shown. Verification/sweep kinds capture retained complete immutable data and original metadata, independent of selection or later membership/view changes

PDF/PNG capture full drawing, ignoring viewport zoom/pan. Page.measurements opts into frozen live display/pinned readings with stale/unavailable labels. SVG always includes its captured display/readings
PDF includes all tiled pages; PNG requires page_index for a multi-page layout. Layout/page-index/16-page/12-megapixel/clip constraints are checked during rendering and can fail after admission
No printer job is submitted; printing has separate captured preview/spool controls
